task_description: Insert a new audit-log entry with an action and a user name.
Find accounts whose email address ends with a given domain.
Show the orders for the customer name stored on a support ticket.
List the students enrolled in a course code.
Mark an invoice as paid by its invoice number (a text code such as INV-2041).
Search apartments by an optional city and an optional maximum rent.
Return the average rating of a product, given its numeric id.
Count sign-ups per country, optionally only for one country.
Change the priority of a task, given its numeric id and the new priority.
Sort the product list by a caller-chosen column and direction.
